body:
Adds `research/impact-twin`: closed-form Zeno rest time `(v1/g)(1+e)/(1-e)` and its sensitivity `2/(1-e^2)` versus a fixed-step semi-implicit-Euler twin (clamp, mirror, crude locate). Twin apparent restitution and settling time are O(dt) off with scheme-dependent sign; first-bounce calibration of `e` is not a reliable fix (helps clamp at coarse dt, worsens mirror). Negative and stylised results are marked as such.

- 10 unit tests pass; `experiments/run.py` reproduces `results.txt`
- README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok (175 projects)
